title: ARC task claim
description: claims/<TASK-ID>/claim.json (legacy stream) or arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/<TASK-ID>/claim.json (ARC namespace, B4 / P-E) - the durable record of one claimed task; claim identity is (arcId ?? null, taskId). Written by arc-worker for its OWN claim only, and by the owner during recovery. UNCLAIMED is not a value here: an unclaimed task is represented by the absence of the claim directory in its namespace.

taskId.description: Must equal the containing directory name.

planId.description: Snapshot this claim was taken against. A mismatch with current.json fails closed to BLOCKED and is owner-recoverable only (W-V8).

conversationId.description: Identifies the holding conversation. Advisory: a dead conversation still retains its mutexes, by design.

mutexes.description: Classes this claim holds, in canonical acquisition order. Sorting is computed on these unencoded strings, never on the encoded directory names.

state.description: AUTHORIZED and ABANDONED are owner-written only. A worker refuses to emit either string under any condition.

stateHistory.description: Append-only transition log. Never rewritten, never truncated.

reason.description: Required in practice when state is BLOCKED. Null otherwise.

mutexesReleasedAt.description: Set after a COMPLETE claim releases its own classes. COMPLETE is written BEFORE release, so a crash between the two strands the mutexes rather than corrupting the audit trail.

resumeCount.description: Incremented by /arc-worker --resume. Non-zero means this claim outlived at least one conversation.

arcId.description: OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). Required in arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/<TASK-ID>/ records and must equal the directory <ARC-ID>; must be absent in claims/<TASK-ID>/ records. The schema validates shape only (D-23): the namespace rule is scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js claimMatchesPath, applied by every reader.

OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). ARC identity. Absent in every legacy record; present in every ARC-scoped record and equal to the ARC it belongs to - the publisher's ARC literal for a snapshot, its manifest and plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json (three-way equality), the arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/ directory for claims, tokens and the holders taken for that ARC. Never inferred from a task-id prefix, a filename or a slug. The reserved Windows device-name guard applies uniformly (N-3). The schema validates shape only; namespace rules live in scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js.
